decisions.reason: A bleaching tray blank line with its own page is a cheap consumable fitting the core thermoforming range, so its uncertain upside is worth more than its small carrying cost.
A PETG thermoforming blank is a low-cost staple in the established material portfolio with its own page, so keeping the option open costs little.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned on the website, which signals weak commitment, but as a niche consumable it costs little to keep while demand is still unclear.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's digital scanning workflow, a strategic direction, and is cheap to carry while its value resolves.
The custom earmold line is produced on existing skilled custom-device manufacturing capacity, so its marginal cost is low and it fits the hearing-care channel.
Custom hearing protection earmolds extend the earmold business into a growth segment at low incremental cost, so the option is worth holding despite limited visibility.
